title: Insignificant Cause
description: An explanation that posits one minor factor, out of several that contributed, as its sole cause. This fallacy also occurs when an explanation is requested, and the one that is given is not sufficient to entirely explain the incident yet it is passed off as if it is sufficient.
logical_form:
Factors A, B, and C caused X.

Factor A, the least significant factor, is said to have caused X.

examples.example: Billy murdered all those people because I spanked him when he was a child.
examples.explanation: Assuming that spanking did contribute to Billy's murderous behavior as an adult (which is a very weak assumption), to sell that as the cause is extremely fallacious.

examples.example: The reason Donald Trump got elected was because liberals took political correctness too far.
examples.explanation: Assuming liberals did take political correctness too far, and this did have some effect on voters in favor of Donald Trump, it is unreasonable to claim that this was "the reason" for his win.

exceptions: Very often causes can be “insignificant” in that they don’t seem meaningful enough considering the meaning of the cause. This is one of the prime drivers of the* *[conspiracy theory](https://www.logicallyfallacious.com/logicalfallacies/Conspiracy-Theory)* fallacy*. For example, a lone gunman seems like an insignificant  cause in the death of John F. Kennedy. This is our bias at work where we want significant causes for significant effects. “Insignificant,” in the context of this fallacy, refers to “insignificant to adequately account for the cause” rather than “insignificant in meaning.”
tips: Establishing causality is very difficult. Be very weary of claims of causality in casual conversation.
references: This a logical fallacy frequently used on the Internet. No academic sources could be found.
description_et: Seletus, mis toob ainsa põhjusena esile ühe väiksema teguri mitmest, mis aitasid kaasa. See eksitus esineb ka siis, kui soovitakse selgitust ja antud selgitus ei ole juhtumi täielikuks selgitamiseks piisav, kuid see edastatakse justkui piisavaks.
logical_form_et:
Faktorid A, B ja C põhjustasid X.

Väidetavalt põhjustas X-i faktor A, kõige vähem oluline tegur.
exceptions_et: Väga sageli võivad põhjused olla "ebaolulised", kuna need ei tundu põhjuse tähendust arvestades piisavalt tähendusrikkad. See on * *[vandenõuteooria](https://www.logicallyfallacious.com/logicalfallacies/Conspiracy-Theory)* eksituse* üks peamisi tõukejõude. Näiteks üksik püssimees tundub John F. Kennedy surma tähtsusetu põhjusena. See on meie eelarvamus tööl, kus soovime olulisi põhjusi oluliste tagajärgede jaoks. "Ebaoluline" viitab selle eksituse kontekstis pigem "ebaolulisele, et põhjust piisavalt arvesse võtta" kui "tähenduslikult ebaolulisele".
tips_et: Põhjusliku seose tuvastamine on väga raske. Olge juhusliku vestluse põhjuslikkuse väidetest väga väsinud.

examples_et.example: Billy mõrvas kõik need inimesed, sest ma peksasin teda, kui ta oli laps.
examples_et.explanation: Eeldades, et löömine aitas kaasa Billy mõrvarlikule käitumisele täiskasvanuna (mis on väga nõrk eeldus), on selle müümine põhjusena äärmiselt ekslik.
examples_et.original_example: Billy murdered all those people because I spanked him when he was a child.
examples_et.original_explanation: Assuming that spanking did contribute to Billy's murderous behavior as an adult (which is a very weak assumption), to sell that as the cause is extremely fallacious.

examples_et.example: Põhjus, miks Donald Trump valituks osutus, oli see, et liberaalid viisid poliitilise korrektsuse liiga kaugele.
examples_et.explanation: Eeldades, et liberaalid viisid poliitilise korrektsuse liiga kaugele ja see avaldas valijatele Donald Trumpi kasuks teatud mõju, on alusetu väita, et see oli tema võidu "põhjus".

examples_et.original_explanation: Assuming liberals did take political correctness too far, and this did have some effect on voters in favor of Donald Trump, it is unreasonable to claim that this was "the reason" for his win.
